scorecard.rationale: The Parkinson prebiotic pilot listed green beans among several menu options and reported composite motor and gastrointestinal scores. Its report and registration supply neither identifiable cooked bean consumption nor fatigue severity. The original cohort names string beans in food-frequency validation. Its adjusted HR 0.83 (95% CI 0.78–0.88) applies to total vegetable intake and incidence of a fatigue component, with cooking and Parkinson comparison unavailable. The relevant supplemental bean-specific estimate has not been verified. Keep the pooled estimate as context and the exact source pair open.
